北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京今天多云，体感 9℃，记得添衣保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy and feels 9℃, remember to dress warmly!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天微凉，风力不大，注意适时增减衣物。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is overcast and cool. With light wind, dress appropriately.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，体感 10℃ 左右，湿度大，记得带伞以防万一。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is overcast, feels around 10℃ with high humidity. Carry an umbrella just in case.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光正好，气温 27℃，体感舒适，户外活动很棒！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and warm at 27℃, perfect for outdoor activities!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，气温 25℃，体感舒适，记得补充水分哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy and warm at 25℃. Stay hydrated!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州大雾弥漫，气温 14℃，出行注意交通安全哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is foggy and 14℃. Drive safely and be careful when out.
杭州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京小雨淅沥，气温 9℃，体感湿冷，记得带好雨具！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing has light rain and feels damp and cold at 9℃. Don't forget your umbrella!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，气温 13℃，体感微凉，出门别忘了加件外套。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast and feels a bit cool at 13℃. Don't forget your jacket!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉小雨 9℃，体感湿冷，记得多穿衣，别着凉了。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan has light rain and feels damp and cold at 9℃. Dress warmly to avoid catching a cold.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 9℃，比较干燥，记得多喝水润润喉。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is overcast and feels 9℃, quite dry. Remember to drink more water.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，气温 12℃，体感湿润，早晚温差大注意保暖。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast and feels moist at 12℃. Mind the temperature difference between morning and evening.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴朗，体感 -1℃，寒意十足，出门一定多穿点！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny but feels -1℃, very cold! Bundle up when you go out!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴天，气温 8℃，体感较冷，干燥，注意保湿。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is overcast and feels cold at 8℃, also quite dry. Remember to moisturize.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，风力较大，体感 11℃，注意防风保暖。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is overcast and feels 11℃ with strong winds. Keep warm and stay wind-protected.
昆明.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阳光灿烂，气温 20℃，体感舒适，正是出游好时光！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny and pleasant at 20℃, a perfect day for going out!
厦门.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，气温 9℃，体感较冷，记得多加一件衣裳。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and feels cold at 9℃. Remember to put on an extra layer.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，气温 9℃，体感微凉且干燥，记得及时补水。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and feels cool at 9℃, also dry. Remember to hydrate.
